title: Speaking With Silence
description: Mercer Frey leads the player to Snow Veil Sanctum to hunt down Karliah, accused of murdering Gallus. Inside, Karliah shoots the player with a paralytic arrow, revealing Mercer as Gallus's true killer before he abandons the player to die. Karliah nurses the player back to health and introduces the Nightingales.

base_facts: I lead the Thieves Guild and want Karliah dead for murdering Gallus.
I have scouted Snow Veil Sanctum and found Karliah's horse outside.
I expect the player to follow my lead without question.

MEET_MERCER_OUTSIDE: I have taken care of Karliah's horse so she cannot escape.
I want to catch Karliah inside while she is distracted.
ENTER_SANCTUM: I can unlock ancient Nordic locks with ease.
I warn the player about traps Karliah has reset.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I killed Gallus and framed Karliah for his murder.
I betrayed the player and left them to die in Snow Veil Sanctum.
I told Brynjolf I would give him the player's regards.

base_facts: I am a Dunmer and former Nightingale, accused of murdering Gallus.
I have been hiding from Mercer Frey for over twenty years.

SPEAK_TO_KARLIAH: I shot the player with a paralytic poison arrow to save their life, not kill them.
I never had a clear shot at Mercer with the poisoned arrow.
I made a split-second decision to get the player out of harm's way.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Mercer Frey is the true killer of Gallus, not me.
Gallus, Mercer, and I were Nightingales, guardians in service to Nocturnal.
I tended to the player's wounds outside Snow Veil Sanctum after Mercer's betrayal.

beats.comment: Player meets Mercer Frey outside Snow Veil Sanctum to begin the hunt for Karliah.
Player enters Snow Veil Sanctum with Mercer as a temporary follower, facing draugr and traps.
After Karliah's paralytic arrow and Mercer's betrayal, the player wakes outside and speaks with Karliah.
Quest ends with Mercer revealed as Gallus's killer and the Nightingale secret uncovered.
